Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
#include<cstdio>
#include<vector>
using namespace std;

class Solution {
public:
    int singleNumber(vector<int>& nums) {
        vector<int> bits(32);

        for (auto num : nums)
        {
            for (int i = 0; i < 32; i++)
            {
                bits[i] += (num >> i) & 1; // num>>i: [二进制下移位]丢掉num末尾i个bit位,     
                  // digit & 1 用于高位清零, 检查数字的最后一位是否为偶数, 比number%2速度快
                  // 于是最后的作用是将第i位转换为二进制的 0/1
            }            
        }
        
        int res = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < 32; i++)
        {
            res += (bits[i] % 3) << i;
        }
        
        return res;
    }
};

// Test
int main()
{
    Solution sol;
    vector<int> nums = {0, 1, 0, 1, 0, 1, 99};
    printf("%d ", sol.singleNumber(nums));
    return 0;
}
